answer.reason: The marked verses tell of his visit to Moses in the wilderness and his sacrifice to God, which go beyond the summary.

clauses.english: brought Zipporah and her two sons to Moses at the mount of God
clauses.quote: I thy father in law Jethro am come unto thee

clauses.english: offered a burnt offering and sacrifices to God
clauses.quote: took a burnt offering and sacrifices for God

doubts: Most marked verses call him Jethro, and NUM 10:29 gives Raguel; I took these as the same man as Reuel, as the record's description implies.
Left out JDG 1:16 and JDG 4:11, which concern the Kenites and Hobab's descendants, and NUM 10:29, which speaks to Hobab.
